response.rationale: Several T1 meta-analyses (Adesope 2017, Yang 2021, Dunlosky 2013) show practice testing and retrieval raise achievement, and the T4 Anki study found that unique cards seen predicted Step 1 scores; the one negative item is the same Deng 2015 study, which only found that Firecracker cards didn't predict scores, so it doesn't really counter the hypothesis. The evidence is mostly causal experiments, not predictive correlations, and the effect is moderate, so confidence stops short of very high.
